name: getnestdoc
description: A terminal documentation reader for NestJS.
author: devenock
//typescript: Pinned exact, no caret — 7.x is the native Go port and removes the JS Compiler API (createSourceFile, createProgram).
//marked: Runtime dependency of `nest-doc update` only, lazy-loaded the same way typescript is. Left unpinned unlike typescript: marked's parser API is stable across its majors.
//overrides: A transitive dependency declares a *range* for @emnapi/core and @emnapi/runtime rather than an exact version, letting the lock file drift depending on install timing. Pinning both removes the ambiguity.
